**Triage: lands in `scripts/` (a new gate) with tests as its subject ⇒ `domain:devx`, ⛔ not skills — the rule TEXT lives on a governed surface but the gate's subject is the test corpus; `priority:p2`.**

This is a **declared-but-unenforced** rule, which SKILL.md routes to the enforce-or-remove channel by name. PR objectui#8952 landed the rule in root `AGENTS.md`:

> ⛔ **测试在断言里读文件系统,根定在它自己的文件上,永不定在 `process.cwd()`。**

and the bullet ends by declaring its own limitation — *"这一条今天没有任何门拦得住:objectui#7799 修掉的是 13 个实例,不是这一类。"*

⇒ p2 rests on a measured base rate, not a worry: **13 defects came out of this class in a single day.** A rule taught to every agent with nothing behind it is the shape the decision framework's third axis names outright — 声明即强制,绝不让 AI 声明一个运行时不兑现的能力. Here the repo is doing that to itself.

### The placement question the card raises, answered

⇒ **The gate goes in `scripts/`, in the devx lane.** The rule sentence sits on a governed surface, but SKILL.md routes a gate by its SUBJECT, and the subject here is every test file in the repo, not `AGENTS.md`. ⛔ Editing the `AGENTS.md` bullet is **not** part of this card — if the gate's arrival makes that ⚠️ sentence stale, that correction is a governed-surface edit and belongs to the skills lane as its own card.

⚠️ Scope by measurement: the honest population is "tests that resolve a repository path", and `process.cwd()` is one spelling of it. ⛔ Do not ship a gate that greps for one spelling and reads as covering the class — that is objectui#8410's standing warning about absence claims.

`Size/model suggestion:` M — the detector's shape is the work.

## ⭐ The placement question this card was filed with is ANSWERED — ⛔ do not re-open it

Triage (`5619737804`):

> ⇒ **The gate goes in `scripts/`, in the devx lane.** The rule sentence sits on a governed surface, but SKILL.md routes a gate by its SUBJECT, and the subject here is every test file in the repo, ⛔ not `AGENTS.md`. ⛔ **Editing the `AGENTS.md` bullet is not part of this card** — if the gate's arrival makes that ⚠️ sentence stale, that correction is a governed-surface edit and belongs to the skills lane as its own card.

⇒ ⛔ no `eslint-rules/` rule, ⛔ no `AGENTS.md` edit, ⛔ no re-litigating either.

## ⚠️ ⭐ The fence that decides whether this round is worth anything

Triage, and it is the whole difficulty:

> ⚠️ Scope by measurement: the honest population is **「tests that resolve a repository path」**, and `process.cwd()` is **one spelling of it**. ⛔ **Do not ship a gate that greps for one spelling and reads as covering the class** — that is objectui#8410's standing warning about absence claims.

⭐ And the card carries the proof that one spelling is not the class: of objectui#7799's **13** genuine defects, **one was invisible to that census's own regex** — it spelled the read as `(globalThis as unknown as {…}).process.cwd()`.

⇒ ⭐ **a detector that a defect can walk around by changing how it spells the call is the failure mode by name.** ⚠️ 「Size M — the detector's shape is the work」, per triage. ⛔ The gate's *placement* is settled; its *shape* is the entire round.

## Premises — only four, ⛔ each yours to re-run, and ⚠️ ONE HAS ALREADY MOVED

| reading | on `origin/main` = `87f174c00` | provenance |
|---|--:|---|
| `eslint-rules/` rule files | **21** | ⚠️ the card measured **10** on `aeaa0f64c` — **the population more than doubled**. ⛔ Do not take the card's number for anything. |
| …of them mentioning `process.cwd` | **0** | control: `export` in `eslint-rules/index.js` → **1**, so the zero is a reading, ⛔ not a dead query |
| the `AGENTS.md` bullet | present, plus a second `process.cwd` mention | ⛔ read-only for you |
| test files under `packages/*/src` mentioning `cwd()` | **26** | ⚠️ objectui#7799's census found **19** on an older tree ⇒ ⭐ **the population has GROWN by 7 since the class was last swept**, which is this card's own argument with a number on it |

⚠️ ⛔ That last row is a **crude grep**, ⛔ not the population. It sees neither the evasive spelling above nor a helper that resolves a path on the test's behalf. ⇒ **it is a floor on the problem, ⛔ not a measure of it** — and deriving the real population is your first deliverable.

## ⛔ Two things the card already measured, ⛔ so they are not rediscovered the hard way

The card names them; ⚠️ this seat has **not** re-derived either, ⇒ re-derive before relying on them:

1. ⛔ The rule must **not** prescribe `new URL(<relative path>, import.meta.url)` — the card says this repository's test tree makes that wrong. **Read the card's own §⚠️ for the reason** and confirm it.
2. objectui#7799's six measured-immune files had **reverse probes proven to have teeth** (the `cli` probe really did fire). ⇒ ⭐ if your gate classifies any of those six, you have a false positive and a worked example to test against.

## Closed — landed as `6a8e2a319a683b5523106a68776b3524814b4982` (PR objectui#9190)

Full LANDED note with all five probe legs: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/9190#issuecomment-5638341553

`AGENTS.md`'s ⚠️ *「这一条今天没有任何门拦得住」* is now false for the `process.cwd()` class. `scripts/check-test-path-roots.mjs` + its pin in `scripts/__tests__/`, plus a step in the existing `Lint` job — ⛔ **no new required check context** (`jobs:`-level keys 5 → 5, steps 17 → 18, verified across the merge).

### What the round got that the card did not

- **⛔ Not a `process.cwd` grep.** The scan starts at the **filesystem call**, resolves the sink by **import provenance** rather than by name — name-matching gave 28 violations, provenance 8, and all 20 of the difference were one test's own local `writeFile` into a `mkdtemp` dir — and resolves the root through the file's own bindings, which is how it found two reads whose own line holds no `cwd` token at all.
- **Three live defects repaired**, and the one that carries the card's argument is `gridArrayArmOrderby-8973.test.tsx`: written **after** objectui#7799 swept the class, justified in its own comment by two premises already falsified when it was written. ⭐ Those comments were **corrected, not deleted** — a defect reasoned from written prose reproduces itself while the prose stands.
- **⚠️ Three of the card's own premises were wrong, and the dev measured all three.** The "six measured-immune files" are **four** (`19 − 13 = 6` is arithmetic on a total no measurement produced). `new URL(REL, import.meta.url)` does **not** throw here — 21 live call sites, measured passing under both cwds — so the gate treats it as self-rooted and ⛔ does not flag it; reddening 21 green files over a hazard that did not reproduce would be a false-positive engine. And the premise **this seat** flagged as "already moved" had not moved: `eslint-rules/` holds 21 `.js` files = **10 rule modules** + 10 tests + `index.js`, and 10 was exactly the card's figure.

### ⛔ What the green does not say

The gate declares **376 unclassified roots** on every run, `--blind` enumerates them, and its largest blind spot is structural: resolution stops at the module edge, so a root arriving as a function parameter or from an import is invisible. One of the three repaired files handed `process.cwd()` straight to a helper that did the reads — found by a human reading the file, ⛔ not by the gate, and labelled in place as the shape the gate misses. ⇒ a clean run is a verdict on the roots this gate can classify, ⛔ never a clean bill of health for the class.

⭐ And that blind spot bit the round that built it. The PR's one red shard was a documentation pin that reads `lint.yml` **through a helper** — invisible to a list of affected pins assembled from filenames. The measurement it prompted: **35** tracked test files actually read `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, against **6** recalled and **21** text-search hits of which 8 are false and 22 are missed. The card's thesis and the round's own failure are the same shape, one level apart.

### Routed, ⛔ not folded in

- **objectui#9188** — the last cwd-rooted read, a Playwright spec that runs only against a live backend. Registered in `KNOWN_CWD_ROOTED`, which is ⛔ shrink-only and pinned at ≤ 1.
- **objectui#9191** — `AGENTS.md` declares `new URL(<相对路径>, import.meta.url)` fatal via a named Vite-transform mechanism while the tree carries 21 live instances inside that transform, and three comments in those files assert the hazard in prose. Governed surface ⇒ ⛔ neither the dev nor this seat touched it; placement is triage's.
- **objectui#9198** — "what reads this file?" has no mechanical answer in this repo, so authors answer it from memory and memory indexes on names.

All three filed bare.
